qt: to the Commission Catherine Griset (PfE) Subject:

On Saturday 17 October 2026, the headquarters of Lagardère News, which is home to Europe 1, CNews and the Journal du Dimanche, was attacked by far-left Antifa activists1. The violence was planned on a Telegram group with more than 3 000 members. One of the group’s administrators is reportedly a former parliamentary staffer for the LFI party who has been prosecuted on a number of occasions for incitement to violence. 1.
Under the Digital Services Act, can the Commission say whether the French authorities are ordering Telegram’s legal representative in Europe to close groups used by Antifa rioters or terrorists?

Under the Horizon Europe research programme, would it consider funding sociological studies on the psychological, toxicological, social and professional profile of participants in these groups, based on aggregated data that could legally be provided by Member States and digital platforms?
